_source: OrcaSlicer — OrcaFilamentLibrary generic base profiles (resources/profiles/OrcaFilamentLibrary/filament/base/fdm_filament_*.json). Repo: https://github.com/SoftFever/OrcaSlicer (AGPL-3.0).
_notes: nozzle_temp_c, bed_temp_c and max_volumetric_speed_mm3s are taken directly from the upstream profiles. In OrcaSlicer retraction is defined at the printer level (filament value 'nil'); only TPU overrides it (0.4mm). retraction values for non-TPU and all retraction speeds are standard direct-drive defaults and are printer-dependent.
